notes: Strategy S6 (game-flow scenarios) from docs/strategy-framework.md, frozen before any bet, any licensed input or any model result exists. The thresholds are policy choices, not findings; no performance claim is made or implied by this file.
signal: Generate distributions of pace, scoring and margin paths and label a scenario only after the trigger and outcome are recorded in advance; condition player props on scenario-dependent minutes.

thresholds.estimator_disagreement_gate: the two independent estimators must agree within 1.0 margin standard deviations; a larger gap is published as a disagreement and is not turned into a pick
thresholds.luck_rule: a strategy whose exposure to a team reaches 0.25 of total weight is refused when that team's measured luck z-score is outside +/- 1.0
thresholds.minimum_sample_rationale: frozen policy choice made before any result exists; it is not derived from a completed power analysis, which remains an open task
thresholds.publish_rule: publish only when the strategy's out-of-sample proper score beats the declared baseline and the game-cluster bootstrap 95% lower bound of that improvement is above zero

universe.settlement_uses: official final score confirmed by two independent official observations
universe.side_convention: the scenario label is recorded before the event and the scenario trigger is fixed in advance
